column3: The Hebrew explicitly says he “lifted his eyes” and introduces the three men with “behold.”
The Hebrew says “strengthen your heart” where BSB has “refresh yourselves.”
The time expression is literally “at the time of life”; “next year” explains it.
The Hebrew says “the way of women had ceased for Sarah” where BSB explains childbearing age.
The Hebrew says Sarah laughed “within herself,” and calls Abraham “my lord” where BSB has “my master.”
The Hebrew says “I have known him” where BSB has “I have chosen him.”
